items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I heard this piano playing... It turned out to be Teddy Wilson playing the piano... I just kind of went ape over it.

ctx.x: to say things negatively about Duke Ellington's band, and then he would talk about some band that he had, and name characters in it. Of course, people like Count Basie and Lester Young and people like that, or Teddy Wilson, he just had no kind of respect for at all, you know!

Yet still, I kept my mouth shut. I had nothing to say, because I had nothing to talk about anyway. But at the same time, I would always come up and listen to him. So after... You know, guys just walked away from him. They called him all kinds of "old-time so-and-so's..." I was left standing there with him. So he said to me, "One of these days you're going to be a good pianist, because you listen." Well, I'd been going up there every day just listening to him because he played the piano, and every now and then…
